scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge or show empathy for the customer's severe distress regarding lost billable CAD work and contract penalty threats at [01:21].

grader.scenario: WiFi dead zone in detached garden office; split 2.4GHz/5GHz SSIDs and positioned booster; agent fails empathy on severe deadline outburst
grader.notes: Technically adept wireless troubleshooting resolving an external signal dead zone in a garden office. However, the agent failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement when the customer suffered a major outburst regarding lost billable CAD work and contract penalty threats, which the agent ignored completely while moving straight into procedural router questions.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:21] Customer: 'I work as a self-employed architectural designer, and the connection has completely dropped out this morning! I've lost four hours of billable project time, and my client has threatened to cancel my contract and fine me two thousand pounds...' ... [01:49] Agent: 'Let's check the router details. What model of S-Net Hub do you have located in the main house?' - Agent ignored emotional distress and financial peril completely.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [02:44] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, your workstation in the detached garden office cannot maintain a stable signal over the eighteen-meter distance through patio glass, causing your drawing uploads to fail. Is that right?' - Accurate and comprehensive restatement.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [11:25] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated case owner for this ticket and log these Wi-Fi configuration adjustments so if you ever need further optimization, our team has full notes.' - Agent takes personal responsibility and documents technical configuration.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [03:22] Agent: 'Obviously high-frequency 5 gigahertz radio waves suffer severe signal attenuation when traveling through modern energy-efficient argon double glazing, Kieran...' - Objective, professional explanation.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [09:34] Customer uploads architectural file at 45 Mbps and confirms full resolution.
